links.comparator_used: Non-tuned GPT-4o baseline using training knowledge alone, without retrieved examination materials
links.outcome: Accuracy on oral and maxillofacial surgery Phase A board examination questions (788 questions, 2017-2024)
links.effect: GPT-4o with RAG 50.9% vs GPT-4o non-tuned 51.4%; pairwise comparison P = 0.788
links.quote: Direct comparison between GPT-4o variants revealed no difference (P = 0.788), indicating that RAG with direct access to examination materials provided no benefit over baseline architecture.
